req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs. The test suite will verify this functionality by checking for a successful response, handling of invalid requests, and boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'Swagger UI' in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: Receive an HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed response.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with a large query string.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
large_query = '?' + 'a' * 1000
response = client.get('/docs' + large_query)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert 'Swagger UI' in response.text
